SmartScore omits low D4 attack6, shifting identities/onsets but remains same physical region. II B4-A4-C5-B4 one slur, not SmartScore tie; PlayScore begins too late at A4 after spurious pickup continuation.
records.correspondence: Original source ordinal equals physical region for I/II; contours and pickup/terminal landmarks checked. PlayScore lower rests are P3/P5. SmartScore P3/P4 contain forward-only measures P023-P041, not evidence that printed rests are absent.
